items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Tim is identified only as the interviewer ('Are we rolling, Tim?'). The interviewee (Jimmy Lewis) does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Tim in the transcript.

ctx.x: Are we rolling, Tim? Well we were talking about the small Basie group. Did it get to the point where Basie wanted the whole band back again?

Yes. Are you ready now? One night, see Freddie Green, he didn’t join the group right away, the small group. But one night he said, “I need Freddie, I’ve got to have him.” He said, “he’s like my left hand.” So he got Freddie, then he said, “I’m going to have to have a big band man, I’m so used to the sound, I’ve got to get the band back. So he got a lot of guys together, and we got the band together and had a rehearsal down to, I think we had this at Club DeLisa. In the daytime we used to go down there, there was…
